reasons.plausibility: The notion that thermally activated diffusion and solid-solution stability drive phase decomposition—and thus affect mechanical properties—is well-grounded in high-entropy alloy physics.
reasons.testability: Comparing treated and baseline samples over a well-defined temperature range and measuring mechanical properties and microstructure is a clear way to falsify or support the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It focuses on fundamental diffusion and phase decomposition mechanisms and provides a straightforward test, though it offers limited new insight beyond established phenomena.
